pool.baseline: The silence in this tent is heavier than the noise of the battle ever was. I can still see their faces in the candle flame... every man I sent into that meat grinder because of my own arrogance. I look at my hands and all I see is the blood of better men than I'll ever be. There is no path forward for someone like me. How can I lead, or even exist, when every breath I take feels like a theft from the men I buried today?

pool.baseline: everything is just gone. i looked at the accounts today and it's actually happening. the house, the business, everything i spent twenty years building... it's all just evaporating. i feel like i'm falling and there's no ground left to hit. i can't even face my family. how do you even look someone in the eye when you've lost everything? i just feel like i'm waiting for the crash.

pool.baseline: i feel like im disappearing. not like im dying, but like the person i was is just... leaking out of me. i look in the mirror and i don't recognize the eyes looking back. it's like i'm watching a stranger live my life and i'm just a passenger in a body that doesn't feel like mine anymore. everything feels so thin and hollow.

pool.baseline: i feel like im just living someone elses life. every single thing i do is for my family or to make people happy with who they think i should be. it’s like i’m a ghost in my own body. there’s no way out of this, everything is just decided for me before i’m even born. i just want to be free of it all.
